thread:
anna-support: Escalation from Support — AcmeCorp seeing repeat 502s and timeouts on hosted inference after billing update. API key sk-acme-01. Started ~2026-03-15T09:12Z. Customer reports "upstream read timeout" in response. They pasted request_id: 01F9ABCD.

sre-alert-bot: [ALERT] hosted-inference.eu-west-1 /v1/generate p99 latency 3.2s, 5xx rate 1.9% (SLO burn). alert_id: A-13579

alex: Can you paste a raw failing response & request ID? Need to check traces and ingress logs.

anna-support: Here's the snippet they sent:
```
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
content-type: application/json
x-request-id: 01F9ABCD
{"error":"upstream read timeout","detail":"handler:authz"}
```
No trace URL in payload.

maya: Dashboard shows a 502 spike at 09:12 that lines up with billing webhook retries for that customer. Also see a small blip of authz 503s. query I ran: logs|= "01F9ABCD" | json | sort by ts

jordan: Loki query to grab similar failures:
```
{job="api-gateway",env="prod",path="/v1/generate"} |= "upstream read timeout" | line_format "{ts} {request_id} {upstream} {status}"
```
Found ~120 hits in 60s window; ~70 have no trace spans attached.

alex: Missing spans is the key — ingress accepted request but we don't see downstream handshakes for many. Sampling looks fine, so suspect span drop at our ingress->upstream proxy for quick failures.

sam: Attempting a quick repro from us-east1 with curl using the customer's key:
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-acme-01" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```
I see `502: upstream read timeout` after ~3s when I spin up parallel 50 reqs.

maya: Looks like timeouts cluster when billing state flips to `past_due` and authz calls the payment service synchronously. If payment svc responds slowly, authz stalls and proxy returns 502.

alex: Short mitigation: increase gateway to upstream timeout to 8s for the impacted route + enable routing fallback to next-model-variant for 30m. Runbook steps: https://internal.redwood/sre/playbooks/ingress-5xx

jordan: I've run the timeout change on prod-canary for eu-west-1 for 30m. Also added extra logging to ingress proxy for authz handshake.

anna-support: Notified customer and asked them to confirm if the errors stop. Billing team investigating webhook backlog & payment gateway latency. :thumbsup:

sre-alert-bot: [UPDATE] alert A-13579 state: recovering — 5xx rate back to baseline.

alex: Follow-up action items: 1) postmortem if recurring, 2) eng-billing to add async fallbacks, 3) eng-auth to degrade gracefully when payment svc times out. Assigning owners: eng-billing, eng-auth, eng-sre.

sam: Will attach perf traces and link when available.
